headline: **MLB Daily Recap: July 13, 2026**
article:
The Pittsburgh Pirates dominated the Milwaukee Brewers in a 14-5 victory, with Paul Skenes earning the win. Henry Davis led the Pirates' offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 3 RBIs. In other action, the Kansas City Royals fell to the Baltimore Orioles 8-2, with Leody Taveras leading the Royals' offense. The New York Yankees secured a 5-3 victory over the Washington Nationals, while the Chicago Cubs took down the Cincinnati Reds 8-4.

Several players have been impacted by injuries, with Keegan Akin being transferred to the 60-day injured list due to left elbow discomfort. Other players on the injured list include Zac Gallen, Chris Martin, Nick Lodolo, William Kempner, Brandon Woodruff, Mike Yastrzemski, and Anthony Banda.

The Baltimore Orioles have bolstered their pitching staff with the addition of Cam Sanders, who was traded from the Pittsburgh Pirates in exchange for cash. The Milwaukee Brewers acquired Braden Shewmake from the Houston Astros, while the Chicago White Sox traded LHP Brandon Eisert and 1B Jacob Gonzalez to the Pittsburgh Pirates for LHP Jaden Woods and future considerations.

top_news.title: **Pirates Blast Past Brewers in Dominant 14-5 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates cruised to a 14-5 win over the Milwaukee Brewers, behind a strong performance from Paul Skenes, who earned the win with 5.1 innings pitched, 7 strikeouts, and 2 earned runs. Henry Davis led the Pirates' offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 3 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Royals Fall to Orioles in Blowout**
top_news.summary: The Kansas City Royals suffered an 8-2 loss to the Baltimore Orioles, with the Orioles dominating the game from start to finish. Leody Taveras led the Royals' offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 3 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Yankees Take Down Nationals 5-3**
top_news.summary: The New York Yankees secured a 5-3 victory over the Washington Nationals, with Curtis Mead leading the offense with a home run and one RBI. On the mound, Ryan Yarbrough earned the win, while Paul Blackburn secured the save.

top_news.title: **Cubs Take Down Reds 8-4**
top_news.summary: The Chicago Cubs secured an 8-4 victory over the Cincinnati Reds, with Matthew Boyd earning the win. Alex Bregman led the Cubs' offense, going 3-for-5 with a home run and 4 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Orioles Update Player Status**
top_news.summary: Baltimore Orioles left-hander Keegan Akin has been transferred from the 15-day injured list to the 60-day injured list due to left elbow discomfort. Akin's status change is the latest update on the Orioles' roster.

top_news.title: **Orioles Acquire Cam Sanders in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Baltimore Orioles have bolstered their pitching staff with the addition of Cam Sanders, who was traded to the team from the Pittsburgh Pirates in exchange for cash.
